restartTournament.intro: 🔄 This will restart all active matches and reload them on servers.
restartTournament.actionEndMatch: Run at_endmatch on all servers with loaded/live matches
restartTournament.hint: Use this if matches are stuck or need a fresh start.

tournaments.title: Tournament
tournaments.empty: This site runs one tournament at a time. Create it, and it shows up here, on Browse and on its event page.

settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.intro: Settings for the whole site, whatever game it runs. Each installed game module has a tab of its own.

steam.title: Steam Integration
steam.apiKeyHelper: Resolves Steam vanity URLs and player info. Leave blank to disable lookups.
steam.statusOk: Steam API key is set and reachable.
steam.statusNotConfigured: Steam API key is not set. Vanity URLs cannot be resolved until you add a key.
steam.statusUnreachable: Steam API key appears set but Steam could not be reached. Check your network or key.
steam.statusError: Failed to check Steam API status. Please try again.

ratings.title: Rating Updates
ratings.description: Control whether completed matches update player Skill Ratings. Disable this for events where an external system (for example your Excel sheet) is the source of truth for ratings.
ratings.toggleLabel: Update player ratings from completed matches
ratings.note: When disabled, all matches will still track stats (ADR, K/D, etc.), but player Skill Ratings will remain unchanged.

registration.title: Player registration
registration.description: Control whether new Steam logins automatically create player records. When disabled, only players created or imported by admins will appear in private tournaments and shuffle pools.
registration.toggleLabel: Allow anyone to register via Steam login
registration.recommendation: Recommended: keep this off for invite‑only or private tournaments so random Steam logins do not pollute the player list.

developer.resetApiDescription: Danger zone: drops and recreates the entire database schema, then reinitializes default data (maps, map pools, etc.). Use only for local development. This is irreversible.
developer.resetApiSuccess: API and database reset successfully. All data has been wiped and defaults reinitialized.
developer.resetApiError: Failed to reset API and database. Check API logs for details.

resetApiDialog.title: Reset API & wipe all data?
resetApiDialog.description: This will drop and recreate the entire database schema. All tournaments, matches, players, teams, ratings, events, logs, and settings will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone. Continue?

site.title: Site
site.description: What this site is called. The admin home uses it as its heading.
site.label: Site name
site.helper: Leave it empty to use "Auto Tournament".
site.saveFailed: Could not save the site name

decide.title: {{teams}} needs a winner
decide.detail: Every map was played and the series is still level.

needsYou.actionFailed: That didn't go through. Try again.
needsYou.reallocateConfirmTitle: Move this match to another server?
needsYou.reallocateConfirmBody: The match will be reassigned to the next available server.
needsYou.forceCancelConfirmBody: This ends the match immediately and marks it as cancelled, even if the server is unreachable.

recent.heading: Recent
recent.closingLine: Everything else runs on its own. You'll only see it here when something needs a decision.

license.title: License
license.description: Paste your Auto Tournament license key for commercial use. It is checked on this server, offline. A license never locks or limits anything: if something is off, it shows here as a notice.
license.loadFailed: Could not read the license status.
license.none: No commercial license key. Free for non-commercial use.
license.invalid: This key could not be verified.
license.invalidShort: The saved key could not be verified.
license.warningsNote: Nothing is blocked or limited. This is only a notice.
license.label: License key
license.helper: Starts with ATL1. After saving, only the license ID is shown.
license.saveFailed: Could not save the license key
license.removeFailed: Could not remove the license key

badge.label: Show "Licensed" on public event pages
badge.note: Off by default. Links to the license's public check page, and only shows while the saved key is valid.
badge.failed: Could not change the public license line
